The 15th PMPC Star Awards for Movies by the Philippine Movie Press Club (PMPC), honored the best Filipino films of 1999. The ceremony took place in March 8, 2003 in Villamore Hall, University of the Philippines, Diliman, Quezon City.
Jose Rizal was the top winner of the night, winning 8 awards including Movie of the Year, Movie Director of the Year, Movie Actor of the Year and Movie Supporting Actor of the Year.
Winners
The following are the nominations for the 15th PMPC Star Awards for Movies, covering films released in 1999.
The Winners are listed below in bold.
Majority category
* Movie of the Year
** José Rizal (GMA Pictures)
* Movie Director of the Year
** Marilou Diaz-Abaya for (José Rizal
* Movie Actor of the Year
** Cesar Montano for (José Rizal
* Movie Actress of the Year
** Vilma Santos for '''Bata, Bata... Pa'no Ka Ginawa?
** Nida Blanca for Sana Pag-ibig Na
* Movie Supporting Actor of the Year
** Jaime Fabregas for José Rizal
* Movie Supporting Actress of the Year
** Anita Linda for Ang Babaeng sa Bubugang Lata
* New Movie Actor of the Year
** Ryan Eigenmann for Gangland
* New Movie Actress of the Year
** Serena Dalrymple for Bata, Bata... Pa'no Ka Ginawa?
* Movie Child Actor of the Year
** Carlo Aquino  for Bata, Bata, Paano Ka Ginawa?
Technical category
* Movie Adapted Screenplay of the Year
** Ricardo Lee, Jun Lana, and Peter Ong Lim for José Rizal
* Movie Editor of the Year
** Jess Navarro and Manet A. Dayrit for  José Rizal
* Movie Production Designer of the Year
** Leo Abaya for José Rizal
* Movie Sound Engineering of the Year
** Albert Michael Idioma for José Rizal
* Movie Scorer of the Year
** Nonong Buencamino for José Rizal
Special awards
* Darling of the Press: Eric Quizon
* Male and Female Stars of the Night: Albert Martinez and Glydel Mercado
* Fairest Skin of the Night: Bernadette Allyson'''
